propositions: When plan review short-circuits on an unchanged plan (PASS path via idempotent_reuse), the returned verdict synthesizes empty advisory/coaching/indeterminate/counts instead of replaying the stored REVIEW_RESULT sidecar, causing loss of findings the last real review surfaced.

The BLOCK path (verdict_reuse) already replays stored blocking/advisory/coaching with reused notation; the PASS path must achieve parity by reading and populating the verdict from the latest sidecar when it matches the material fingerprint.

The CLI notation must unmistakably state that rendered findings are the last review's result replayed (not a fresh LLM run) and include the stored review's recency anchor (verified_at_sha/reviewed_at) when available for staleness judgment.

When the latest sidecar is absent, unreadable, mismatched, or contradictory, reuse must degrade gracefully to empty-list behavior while preserving the attestation as the validity authority (do not let sidecar problems block valid reuse).
